Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Object, app As Object, s As String, v As String, r As Variant
    Set app = Application
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        app.Undo
    Case 1
        r = app.Undo
    Case 2
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: app.Undo: r = ws.Range("A1").Value
    Case 3
        app.Repeat
    Case 4
        r = app.Repeat
    Case 5
        ws.Range("A1").Value = 1: app.Repeat: r = ws.Range("A2").Value
    Case 6
        app.OnUndo "Undo it", "Nothing"
    Case 7
        r = app.OnUndo("Undo it", "Nothing")
    Case 8
        app.OnUndo "Undo it", "Nothing": app.Undo
    Case 9
        app.OnUndo "Undo it"
    Case 10
        app.OnUndo
    Case 11
        app.OnUndo "", ""
    Case 12
        app.OnUndo 5, 6
    Case 13
        app.OnRepeat "Again", "Nothing"
    Case 14
        r = app.OnRepeat("Again", "Nothing")
    Case 15
        app.OnRepeat "Again"
    Case 16
        app.OnRepeat
    Case 17
        app.OnRepeat "", ""
    Case 18
        app.OnKey "^+{F12}", "": app.OnKey "^+{F12}"
    Case 19
        r = app.OnKey("^+{F12}", ""): app.OnKey "^+{F12}"
    Case 20
        r = app.OnKey("^+{F12}")
    Case 21
        app.OnKey "^+{F12}", "Nothing": app.OnKey "^+{F12}"
    Case 22
        app.OnKey "^+z", "": app.OnKey "^+z"
    Case 23
        app.OnKey "%+{F11}", "": app.OnKey "%+{F11}"
    Case 24
        app.OnKey "{NOSUCHKEY}", ""
    Case 25
        app.OnKey "", ""
    Case 26
        app.OnKey "^+{F12}{F11}", ""
    Case 27
        app.OnKey
    Case 28
        app.OnKey 5
    Case 29
        app.OnKey Key:="^+{F12}", Procedure:="": app.OnKey Key:="^+{F12}"
    Case 30
        r = app.CheckAbort
    Case 31
        app.CheckAbort
    Case 32
        r = app.CheckAbort(Nothing)
    Case 33
        r = app.CheckAbort(ws.Range("A1"))
    Case 34
        r = app.CheckAbort(5)
    Case 35
        r = app.WindowState
    Case 36
        r = app.IgnoreRemoteRequests
    Case 37
        r = app.AutomationSecurity
    Case 38
        r = app.MultiThreadedCalculation.Enabled
    Case 39
        r = TypeName(app.MultiThreadedCalculation)
    Case 40
        r = app.MultiThreadedCalculation.ThreadMode
    Case 41
        r = app.AlwaysUseClearType
    Case 42
        r = app.WindowsForPens
    Case 43
        r = TypeName(app.AddIns)
    Case 44
        r = app.AddIns.Count >= 0
    Case 45
        r = TypeName(app.AddIns2)
    Case 46
        r = TypeName(app.RecentFiles)
    Case 47
        r = app.RecentFiles.Maximum >= 0
    Case 48
        r = TypeName(app.AutoCorrect)
    Case 49
        r = app.MaxSupportedCompatibilityVersion
    Case 50
        r = TypeName(app.PreviousSelections)
    Case 51
        r = IsEmpty(app.PreviousSelections)
    Case 52
        r = app.DisplayXMLSourcePane
    Case 53
        r = app.MailSystem
    Case 54
        r = app.TransitionMenuKey
    Case 55
        r = app.TransitionMenuKeyAction
    Case 56
        r = TypeName(app.Watches)
    Case 57
        r = app.Watches.Count
    Case 58
        r = TypeName(app.Speech)
    Case 59
        r = TypeName(app.SpellingOptions)
    Case 60
        r = TypeName(app.DefaultWebOptions)
    Case 61
        r = TypeName(app.DefaultPivotTableLayoutOptions)
    Case 62
        r = TypeName(app.LanguageSettings)
    Case 63
        r = TypeName(app.AutoRecover)
    Case 64
        r = app.AutoRecover.Enabled
    Case 65
        r = TypeName(app.UsedObjects)
    Case 66
        r = app.UsedObjects.Count > 0
    Case 67
        r = TypeName(app.ClipboardFormats)
    Case 68
        r = TypeName(app.ODBCErrors)
    Case 69
        r = app.ODBCErrors.Count
    Case 70
        r = TypeName(app.OLEDBErrors)
    Case 71
        r = app.OLEDBErrors.Count
    Case 72
        r = TypeName(app.Excel4MacroSheets)
    Case 73
        r = app.Excel4MacroSheets.Count
    Case 74
        r = app.Excel4IntlMacroSheets.Count
    Case 75
        r = TypeName(app.FileConverters)
    Case 76
        r = TypeName(app.RegisteredFunctions)
    Case 77
        r = TypeName(app.ProtectedViewWindows)
    Case 78
        r = app.ProtectedViewWindows.Count
    Case 79
        r = TypeName(app.ActiveProtectedViewWindow)
    Case 80
        r = TypeName(app.COMAddIns)
    Case 81
        r = TypeName(app.CommandBars)
    Case 82
        r = TypeName(app.VBE)
    Case 83
        r = app.Hwnd > 0
    Case 84
        r = app.Hinstance <> 0
    Case 85
        r = TypeName(app.Hwnd)
    Case 86
        r = TypeName(app.Height)
    Case 87
        r = TypeName(app.Width)
    Case 88
        r = TypeName(app.UsableHeight)
    Case 89
        r = app.Height > 0
    Case 90
        r = app.UsableWidth > 0
    End Select
    s = "ok "
Answered:
    On Error Resume Next
    Err.Clear
    v = "": v = CStr(r)
    If Err.Number Then v = "E" & Err.Number
    s = s & "|" & v
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " "
    Resume Answered
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
